## About
Nalley Toyota Stonecrest Service Center looks after Toyotas for neighbors in Stonecrest, Lithonia, Conyers and the surrounding Atlanta area. Our technicians are factory-trained on Toyota vehicles, and we use Genuine Toyota Parts made for your make and model.
We handle the routine stuff like oil changes and alignments, plus bigger jobs like transmissions and tire replacements. We also help with warranty coverage and recall repairs, and we do a complete multi-point inspection every time your car comes in.
Drivers have rated us 4.7 from 1991 Google reviews. You can wait in our lounge, use the shuttle, or schedule your visit online.

## Services
- Toyota express maintenance: The usual maintenance services, done faster.
- Oil and filter change: Regular oil and filter changes using genuine Toyota Motor Oil and filters, synthetic or conventional.
- Brake service and repair: Brake inspections and repairs to keep your Toyota stopping the way it should.
- 4-wheel alignment: If your car pulls to one side, an alignment helps protect your tires from early wear.
- Battery replacement: Battery replacement with OEM parts.
- Transmission service: Service for your Toyota's transmission.
- Check engine light: Bring it in when the check engine light comes on and we will take a look.
- Diagnostic tests: Diagnostic testing to track down what your Toyota needs.
- Warranty and recall repairs: We help with warranty coverage and recall repairs to keep your Toyota running properly.

## FAQ
Q: Is the service department open on Saturday?
A: Yes, the service department is open on Saturday. It is closed on Sunday.

Q: How often does my Toyota need an oil change?
A: Most Toyotas around Stonecrest need a synthetic oil change every 10,000 miles. A lot of idling in traffic can mean you need one sooner.

Q: What does ToyotaCare cover?
A: ToyotaCare covers no-cost oil changes, tire rotations and multi-point inspections for 12 months or 25,000 miles, plus roadside assistance.

Q: How often should I rotate my tires?
A: We recommend a tire rotation every 5,000 to 7,500 miles.

Q: Can you help with collision repairs?
A: Yes. Nalley Collision Center Lithonia can help with collision repairs.
